title: Prove Printed.lcaTopologicalLie_dual_locallyCompact_false (Lemma D.1.6.4, p. 766)
body:
Proves the refutation of the printed local compactness clause of Lemma D.1.6.4 (p. 766), ERRATA F231.

Closes #5756

**Counterexample.** G = `ULift (ℕ → Circle)` (compact, Hausdorff). Through `lcaTopologicalLie_dual`, the hom group `PontryaginDual G →ₜ* PontryaginDual (Multiplicative ℝ)` is homeomorphic to the one-parameter subgroups `Multiplicative ℝ →ₜ* G`. A compact neighbourhood C of 1 there contains, for some N, every one-parameter subgroup concentrated on coordinate N (a compact-open neighbourhood of 1 only restricts finitely many coordinates). Projecting C to coordinate N then covers all of `Multiplicative ℝ →ₜ* Circle`, which would make the dual of ℝ, hence ℝ (`exists_realPontryaginDualEquiv`), compact.
